reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getRangeAmount/getPlannedAmount pair, which every schedule amount path already calls, and keeps getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is added outside the two shared functions.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree defines the planned schedule amount.

scope.why: Focused on the rule, tests and comments, with a small unrelated import reorder in the test; the comment in forecast-schedules.ts still describes the old 'furthest from zero' rule.

maintainability.why: Two one-line rule edits in a single place are easy to own; per-site comments restating the rule are a drift risk, as the stale forecast comment shows.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers keep going through getPlannedAmount.
